subject: english
question:
Choose the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Back to back

options.text: Present and discuss the details of something.
Do something very fast or with great energy.
Something follows immediately after something else.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Back to back"** means something that follows immediately after something else. (लगातार)

 
 
• **Example: **We had **back-to-back** meetings throughout the day.
 
 
 
• **"Something follows immediately after something else"** refers to events or activities that occur one right after the other without any break. (लगातार होने वाली घटनाएँ)
 
 
• **Example: **The team played three back-to-back matches and won them all.
 
 
 
• Hence, the meaning of **"Back to back"** is clearly represented by **"Something follows immediately after something else"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Present and discuss the details of something** (किसी चीज़ का विवरण प्रस्तुत करना और चर्चा करना):

 
 
• **Example:** The manager asked us to present and discuss the details of the new project.
 
 
 
• **Do something very fast or with great energy** (बहुत तेजी से या बहुत ऊर्जा के साथ कुछ करना):
 
 
• **Example: **He completed the assignment very fast or with great energy to meet the deadline.
 
 
 
• **Try to get something** (कुछ पाने की कोशिश करना):
 
 
• **Example: **She is trying to get a scholarship for her higher studies..
 
 

57:Tc0e,
The correct answer is **Option 3**.
